about: User report 2026-10-06: standing at 391.94 -412.03 on sp_a1_intro4_relit, the sun-through-the-ceiling light (the light_spot at 557.9 -258.2 522.9 with its leaf shadows) lost its shadow when the camera turned to 4.6 -146.89 and came back at 0 -114.22. The view's shadow plan held more shadowed lights than its atlas had tiles at their wanted size; the light ranked late and lost its tile. Positions are the player's feet (cl_showpos reports the eye, 64 units higher).
